name: java-module-selection-relies-on-lexical-walk
body: `CallGraphBuilder.main` physically resolves each `--module` root but re-expresses it under the scan root's lexical spelling when it lies inside it, so selection relies on `SourceDiscovery.collect` continuing to emit `p.toAbsolutePath().normalize()` lexical paths for a possibly symlink-spelled root; an out-of-tree absolute value keeps its physical spelling, which is harmless because the walk never visits outside the root. Upgrade to resolving the scan root once and passing it to `collect`/`ScanRunner` when the walk's path spelling changes.
